description: This is a PHP source file defining the AuthSelectionMiddleware class used for handling authentication scheme resolution within the AWS SDK. It manages middleware creation and applies the selected authentication scheme to commands based on service metadata.

classes.name: Aws/Auth/AuthSelectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for selecting and applying the correct authentication scheme based on service and operation metadata.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function that initializes the AuthSelectionMiddleware with resolver and service instances.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize middleware with handler, resolver, and API service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Method invoked on middleware execution to select and assign the appropriate auth scheme to a command.
